For the character of the day from Misty Meets Her Match, see Mahri.
----
 
Marie (Japanese: ツカサ Tsukasa) is a character of the day who appeared in Type Casting.

She and Pierre were trying to determine whether was a type or a type. She argued that knowledge written in books is not always right. During their field research, Marie witnessed Sudowoodo perform the moves and , which is impossible for any Rock-type Pokémon to learn, therefore she concluded that Sudowoodo was a Grass Pokémon. Eventually, they learned Sudowoodo was in fact a Rock type after noticing the wild one they were studying was afraid of water, which is abnormal for a Grass-type Pokémon. With the use of the move , Sudowoodo was able to imitate moves not of its type.

Her grandfather was inspired by Marie's hope in finding a Sudowoodo and was willing to offer anyone who caught a Sudowoodo on his behalf a trip to the other side of a river with his boat.
